lede: The item worth circling on your calendar this week is Wednesday's Ecology Commission meeting, where a draft ordinance to phase out gas-powered lawn and garden equipment inside town limits — leaf blowers gone by 2028, everything else by 2030 — gets a public airing before it moves further in the process. The rest of the week is quieter on the civic front, with several agendas still unposted, while Halloween tips the weekend toward parades, parties, and a TMHS and Telluride Theatre production of Young Frankenstein running Friday and Saturday.
